mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes was most worthwhile: the seed pieces became a substantial crop, giving the earlier growing work a satisfying payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the beans and then heating them were clear but rather straightforward separate steps.

surprise.text: The pressure-release and tenderness check made the bean cooking more deliberate than I expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the separate heating steps had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The meal was a satisfying payoff, and I would be curious to see how the specimens and return journey unfold.
